category_title: Year 4 pupil with ADHD symptoms (hyperactivity, impulsivity, and learning difficulties)
minimal_context: Yiannis is expected to remain seated at his desk and work on his reading assignment during the 90-minute Literacy block.
dialogue:
TUTOR: We are starting our 90-minute Literacy block now. Please sit at your desk and begin your reading assignment.

STUDENT: (Looks highly distracted and moves back and forth in his chair in a nervous manner.)

TUTOR: Please look at your book and keep trying to read.

STUDENT: (Shows great difficulty sitting on his chair, constantly moving back and forth without looking at the assignment.)

TUTOR: Yiannis, you need to stay in your seat and do your work.

STUDENT: (Leaves his seat completely and begins moving around in the classroom.)

options.A: Move the 90-minute Literacy block to an earlier time in the daily schedule, such as the morning after the first break.
options.B: Pin reader-friendly class rules with colors and pictures close to Yiannis' seat, having them signed by everyone in Year 4 as a contract.
options.C: Invite the students to participate in choral reading of a shared text during the 90-minute Literacy block.
options.D: Recognize the challenging behavior during the 90-minute Literacy block and maintain patience as the student moves around the classroom.
